scenario: Three planes per LSTO.9.1 — facts + samples + cache. Cache carries a sync-read affordance the other two do not. Pin: a rule writing the cache plane and asserting a fact compiles. The storage planes are deferred with the storage layer.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Marker scope ttl 1_min:
    x: Int

rule r:
    Trig t
->
    cache key: "k" value: t.v
    emit Marker x: t.v
